name: oc-be-tools
description: Backend development toolkit for Opencell Core — agents for building entities, services, APIs, tests, and Postman collections, guideline-loading skills, an implementation orchestrator (/oc-be-implement) whose sub-agents record file manifests, a two-axis code review command (/oc-be-review) that checks both coding-guideline conformance (oc-be-pr-reviewer) and requirements conformance against the JIRA ticket's acceptance criteria / test scenarios (oc-be-conformance-reviewer, DEEP multi-agent by default, LIGHT single-pass optional), with a SonarQube quality-gate summary, folding all three axes into one verdict and tagging the ticket ai_code_review_back, and an AI-usage estimator (/oc-be-calculate-ai-use) with per-category line/contribution/retention breakdowns, unit-test and Postman assertion/test-case counts, reviewer-rework provenance, developer-interaction counts, a planning/analysis effort axis, ai_Dev_back / ai_test_back_dev Jira tagging, and a machine-readable JSON record (per domain/user) stored in a dedicated field for reporting
